name: Birdhouse
blurb: A simple house for small birds like wrens and chickadees.

steps.text: Measure, mark and cut all the parts from the 1x6.
Drill the 1-1/4 inch entry hole in the front.
Glue and nail the sides to the floor.
Glue and nail the front and back on.
Sand the edges. Leave the inside unfinished for the birds.
